name: bracket-dashboard
description: Local-first tournament bracket dashboard and OBS overlay system powered by start.gg

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bracket/shared && npm run build -w @bracket/web && npm run build -w @bracket/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @bracket/server" "npm run dev -w @bracket/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bracket/shared && npm run test -w @bracket/server
